Definition: Chavilah, the name of two or three eastern regions; also perhaps of two men
BiblicalUsage: Havilah is a land, and it is also two men. The land of Havilah is where gold lies, compassed by the river Pison; Havilah the son of Cush and Havilah the son of Joktan are both named in the table of nations; and Saul smites the Amalekites from Havilah to Shur.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe one name can hold a land and two men without confusion, because God keeps the record straight. Havilah's gold, Havilah's sons, and Havilah's border are all His.
RelatedPeople: Havilah, Son of Cush; Havilah, Son of Joktan
RelatedEvents: Creation; Anointing of Saul as King
